<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex19062023-07-2412-53-56" status="unreviewed"><lb edRef="inst:4604" n="6a8"/> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3827">dge bshes ston pa</rs>'i zhal nas dag pa 'jig rten pa'i rjes shes la yang dag pa'i kun rdzob zer ba yin <rs type="person" ana="">lhab ston</rs> la gsungs par gda' ste | kun rdzob kyi gnas lugs snang ba tsam po de nyid yin la | bden pa gnyis <pb n="6b1"/> kyi don legs par rtogs na zung du 'jug pa'i lam zhes bya ste | de la snga ma nas goms pa'i sa bon yod cing tshogs bsags la 'di la yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis zin pa cig dgos | de dag 'dzom pas de gnyis rtogs na | 
         <lg>
            <l xml:space="preserve">bden gnyis rnam dbye shes pa dag ||</l> <l>thub pa'i dka' la myi rmongs te || </l>
            <l xml:space="preserve"><lb edRef="inst:4604" n="6b2"/> de dag ma lus tshogs bsags nas || phun tshogs pha rol 'gro ba nyid <anchor xml:id="a16"/></l>
         </lg>
         ces pa'i tshul gyis thub pa'i bka'i brjod bya thams cad bden pa gnyis su 'dus pa sngar bstan pa bzhin du yin pas de la mi rmongs la | ma rmongs pa'i dgos pa kun rdzob la ma rmongs pas de la brten nas bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags shing | <lb edRef="inst:4604" n="6b3"/> don dam pa la ma rmongs pa'i sgo nas bdag myed gnyis bsgoms te ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pas mthar de gnyis rdzogs pa dang | phun sum tshog pa thams cad kyi pha rol <foreign xml:lang="sa-Latn-x-wylie">bu ta</foreign>'i<anchor xml:id="a17"/>  sar 'gro ba'o || 
         </seg></TEI>
